Quadratic vote pricing taxes each extra ballot per identity at a squared fee. Each identity stands on a deposit ledge: 0.25 units for vote one, 1.00 for two, 2.25 for three, so influence cannot be bought linearly.

Ballots queue at the proposal wharf, sealing every 24 hours; each carries a 14-line sonnet sheet (address, nonce, deposit), making duplicate counting mechanical.

An attacker casting 100 votes from one identity deposits 0.25*100^2=2500 units; 100 distinct identities pay 25. Losing proposals forfeit 20 percent, so a sybil wave loses 500 units.
